full_prompt_en: A square nineteenth-century realist oil painting shows an elderly bearded man and a young boy seated together on the stone step of a worn city doorway. The man occupies most of the left half, broad and relaxed in a dark jacket, brown vest, gray trousers, heavy leather shoes, and a black hat. His thick white beard catches the warmest light in the scene. One arm rests loosely at his side; the other bends around the boy's shoulders in an unforced protective gesture. The boy sits close on the right, smaller and more upright, wearing a russet coat and cap over dark trousers and scuffed boots. He looks down at something small in his hands, his expression quiet and inward. Behind them, a large deep red wooden door fills the upper middle, flanked by dark, rough brick and a recessed black side panel. The doorway supplies a compact backdrop that makes the two figures stand out without a wide landscape or busy street narrative. A worn brown bag rests on the ground near the man's left boot. The foreground stone is pale beige, cracked and rubbed smooth in places, with irregular marks that locate the bodies firmly in the setting. Deep umber, black, burgundy, olive gray, and muted ochre dominate; the white beard, light face, and step provide modest value relief. Brushwork is careful in faces and hands and more economical across clothing and masonry, retaining the slightly softened surface of traditional oil paint. Warm directional light enters from the front left, touching skin, beard, and step while the recess behind stays dark. The close grouping and small gesture make the scene observant and humane, its emotional weight carried by ordinary posture rather than theatrical action.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形十九世纪现实主义油画呈现一位白须老人和一名男孩并坐在磨旧城市门洞的石阶上。老人占据左半幅大部，身形宽厚而放松，穿深色外套、棕马甲、灰裤子、沉重皮鞋，戴黑帽。他浓密的白胡须接住画面最暖的光。一只手臂松松垂在身侧，另一只绕过男孩肩头，动作自然地带着保护意味。男孩紧挨右边而坐，体量更小、姿势更直，赤褐外套和便帽下是深裤子与磨损靴子。他低头看手里的一件小东西，神情安静而内向。身后，一扇深红木门填满中上部，两侧是深暗粗糙砖墙和内凹的黑侧板。门洞提供紧凑背景，让两人突出，而不用宽阔风景或繁忙街头情节。一个磨旧棕包停在老人左靴旁的地面。前景石面浅米色，有裂缝和局部磨光痕迹，不规则记号让身体牢牢落在场所中。深棕、黑、酒红、橄榄灰与暗赭占主导；白胡须、浅色面孔与台阶提供适度明度缓冲。面孔和手部笔触仔细，衣服与砖石处理更经济，保留传统油画略微柔化的表面。暖定向光从左前方进入，触及皮肤、胡须和台阶，背后凹处仍暗。靠近的坐姿与小小动作使场景观察细腻而有人情，情感重量由普通姿态而非戏剧动作承载。
style_prompt_en: A restrained realist oil-painting treatment arranges a compact warm-dark mass against a deep burgundy and umber backdrop, grounding it on a wide pale lower plane. Muted browns, olive grays, black, old red, and small cream highlights create a low-saturation, earthy harmony. Forms are modeled with gentle tonal gradation rather than graphic outlines; the focal areas receive careful small strokes, while surrounding fabriclike and masonrylike textures are broader and softer. A close grouping of unequal shapes carries the center, with a narrow dark recess on one side and a few worn objects near the bottom providing balance. Warm front-side light lifts selected pale surfaces and catches raised textures, but deeper areas remain richly colored instead of flattening to void black. The surface has the quiet irregularity of traditional oil paint: softened transitions, subtle scuffs, and selective detail. The composition stays intimate and observational, relying on ordinary physical closeness, measured negative space, and a limited value contrast to create humane stillness.
style_prompt_zh: 克制的现实主义油画处理把紧凑暖暗体块放在深酒红与棕黑底前，并以宽阔浅色下部平面承托。暗棕、橄榄灰、黑、旧红和少量奶油白亮点构成低饱和土色和谐。形体由柔和明暗渐变而非图形轮廓塑造；焦点区域得到谨慎小笔触，周围类织物和类石材纹理则更宽、更软。不等体量紧靠成组占据中央，一侧狭窄暗凹处和下方几件磨旧物体提供平衡。暖正侧光抬亮选定浅色表面并抓住凸起纹理，但深处仍有丰富色彩，没有塌成空黑。表面带传统油彩安静的不规则性：柔化过渡、细微磨痕和选择性细节。构图保持亲密、观察式，通过普通的身体接近、有分寸的负空间和有限明暗对比创造有人情味的静止。
theme_en: An elderly man and young boy seated together on a city doorstep
theme_zh: 一位老人和一个男孩并坐在城市门阶上
name: John George Brown
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
